Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Power BI Developer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Microsoft Power BI, Snowflake, ETL. This role requires a professional who can design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade reporting, analytics, and process automation solutions while collaborating closely with business stakeholders and technical teams.
 Responsibilities: 
 • Building end-to-end Power BI reports and dashboards.
 • Creating data models and managing relationships between multiple data sources.
 • Understanding star schema and dimensional modeling concepts.
 • Developing DAX measures, calculated columns and KPIs.
 • Performing data transformation and cleansing using Power Query (M Language).
 • Creating interactive visualizations and storytelling dashboards.
 • Report optimization and performance tuning - FlowViz
 Mandatory Skills Description: 
 Strong hands-on Power BI experience (5+ years)
 • Snowflake architecture and core concepts.
 • Loading and ingesting data from different sources (Including Raw data)
 • Data transformation and preparation within Snowflake.
 • Understanding of ETL/ELT processes.
 • Working with structured and semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet, etc.).
 • Performance optimization basics (clustering, partitioning concepts, query performance).
 • Writing complex queries using:
 o Joins (Inner, Left, Right, Full)
 o Subqueries
 o CTEs (Common Table Expressions)
 o Window functions
 o Aggregations and grouping
 o Case statements
 • Query optimization and troubleshooting.
 • Data quality validation and reconciliation.
 • Ability to transform, clean and prepare data for reporting.
 Nice-to-Have Skills Description: 
 • Azure DevOps experience or similar tools experience.
 • Ability to identify manual processes and implement automation solutions that improve efficiency, data quality and reporting reliability
